# Contract Analyzer - Extraction History

Companion workflow to Contract Analyzer. Backs the Upload Document dashboard's
KPI tiles and recent-uploads list — every extraction is already logged to the
`extractions` table by the main workflow (Log Extraction to Supabase), this
just reads that log back out.

RLS is on with no policies on `extractions`, and the frontend has no Supabase
credentials at all, so this read has to go through n8n (using the same
service-role credential as the main workflow) rather than a direct-from-
browser Supabase query.

## How it works
1. GET request, no body.
2. Fetch up to 200 most recent rows (id, created_at, file_name, contract_type,
   key_terms, needs_human_review, self_consistency_runs) — raw_response/model/
   latency_ms are skipped, not needed for this view.
3. Compute each row's verification_rate server-side (verified fields / total
   tracked fields) so the frontend doesn't duplicate that logic.
4. Frontend does its own date-range filtering and KPI aggregation client-side
   from this one list — simplest thing that works at demo scale, avoids a
   separate query shape per time filter.

## Setup
1. Import, reconnect the Supabase credential (service role — same as Contract
   Analyzer's), publish.
2. Set this workflow's Settings -> Error Workflow to "Contract Analyzer -
   Error Handler" too, same as the main workflow.
3. Copy the production webhook URL into frontend/config.js as historyWebhookUrl.

## What this does NOT do
No pagination (fine at demo scale, would need it past a few hundred rows), no
server-side date filtering (frontend does it from the same 200-row list), no
auth/multi-tenant scoping — every extraction from every user of this demo
shows up in one shared history.
